title: Open a small page
summary: Selenium controls a browser through WebDriver. A data URL can hold a tiny HTML page for a local practice test.
introduction: Selenium controls a browser through WebDriver. A data URL can hold a tiny HTML page for a local practice test. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Selenium controls a browser through WebDriver. A data URL can hold a tiny HTML page for a local practice test.

blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.text: These examples need Python, Selenium and a compatible installed browser in a local test project. Selenium Manager may download a driver. They do not run in this website's playground.
This course teaches the basics. It does not cover every feature of Selenium. Keep real personal data and secret keys out of practice files.

blocks.code:
from urllib.parse import quote from selenium import webdriver from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By driver = webdriver.Chrome() try: driver.get("data:text/html;charset=utf-8," + quote('

Library

')) assert driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, "h1").text == "Library" finally: driver.quit()
blocks.title: Open a small page

blocks.text: The check passes when the heading says Library.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Change the heading and expected text.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Close the driver in finally so a failed check does not leave a browser open.
For more detail later, use this [Selenium further reading](https://www.selenium.dev/documentation/webdriver/).
